purpose: Improve display-PWM reference dynamics and verifiable controlled startup, without reclassifying numerical or optical evidence.

preserved_contract.led_model: Original synthetic N=3 RS=50ohm CJO=2pF TT=1ns; unchanged

predeclared_diagnostic_order: Audit ideal PERMIT source timeline: previous strict failures at61ps/273ps occur while PERMIT is constant zero; a named trouble node is not root-cause proof.
Separate the same physical circuit's PWL breakpoint mesh and numerical integration settings from finite source output impedance (1/10/50ohm engineering model, not a PDK digital-cell claim).
Compare measured VREF-to-CTRL, VREF-to-SENSE and normalized ILED AC transfer; retain original 30pF compensation and 30pF sense budget initially.
Test supply-to-CTRL feedforward capacitor chosen from the original 30pF compensation: first 60pF analytical candidate, not an unrestricted parameter sweep.

If feedforward is stable and useful, add a small actual MOS supply-enable module with finite passive gate charging to produce a continuous controlled local reference ramp; external START and FAULT sequencing remain explicit.
Freeze selected connections/sizes and hand them to physical agent; use its actual new PEX for final regression. External components are never called extracted on-chip devices.

candidate_options.A_minimal: Keep the reference servo and external VSET boundary; add supply-to-CTRL feedforward plus two-MOS controlled supply enable and explicit passive gate charge shaping. Seek improved high-frequency PSRR without 10us input filtering.
candidate_options.B_fallback: Rebuild the reference amplifier/mirror supply rejection or add a locally regulated reference supply. Greater transistor/headroom/loop interaction cost; do not implement unless A's causal tests fail.

selected_first_option: A_minimal, provisional until AC and transient measurements; 60pF is a diagnostic candidate, not an accepted design.
boundaries: No autonomous POR/brownout claim; any START/FAULT timing assumption is recorded.
VSET is initially an external ideal0.5V boundary; later finite impedance/error controls are not an internally verified bandgap.
The initial GPIO model is an external driver-impedance hypothesis. Pin source correction and actual circuit changes have separate case identities.
Original directories are read-only. No silicon, optical, foundry reliability, tapeout or array claim.

resources.failure_identity_policy: New immutable case for every changed physical or numerical input; failed logs retained; validated raw gzip roundtrip checked.
